title: Stimulant Addiction (Cocaine & Methamphetamine)
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from stimulant addiction, including
cocaine and methamphetamine dependence. Recovery is a journey of restoring your physical health,
renewing your mind, and rebuilding your life. These affirmations encourage perseverance, self-compassion,
emotional resilience, and hope. They are intended to complement professional treatment, counseling,
medical care, and peer support.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder: Recovery is possible with support. Seeking help is a sign of strength.
safety.escalation: Stimulant dependence can involve severe exhaustion, mood crash, and medical risk. Seek professional care for safety planning and recovery support.

modules.title: Awareness & Commitment
focus: I acknowledge my addiction without allowing it to define my future.
Recovery begins with one healthy choice at a time.
Every stimulant-free day is a victory.

modules.title: Healing & Self-Care
focus: My brain and body are restoring themselves every day.
I practice patience and self-compassion throughout my recovery.
I choose healthy ways to manage stress and emotions.

modules.title: Strength & Growth
focus: I am stronger than my cravings.
Every challenge builds my resilience and confidence.
Healthy habits are becoming my new lifestyle.

modules.title: Freedom & Purpose
focus: I embrace a future filled with clarity, stability, and hope.
Recovery is becoming my new way of life.
I am building a meaningful future based on integrity, health, and purpose.

activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by stimulant addiction or my past choices. I am defined by my courage to heal, my
strength to persevere, and my commitment to building a better future. Every day I choose recovery, I
restore my health, renew my mind, and reclaim my life. One step, one choice, and one day at a time, I
am creating a future filled with peace, purpose, and lasting freedom.
